purpose: Publish Notifications, Inbox and an Inbox default update through normal authenticated Studio authoring and signed publication APIs; verify target readers in Neon, Mesh and Studio.
constraints: Existing MFA and independent-review checks remain enforced.

The permission catalog scopes authoring grants to the tenant, not individual drafts. These permissions temporarily cover all configuration drafts in this tenant; the setup script uses only its collection fixture drafts.
No Neon or Mesh permission changes. Each target reader uses its own authenticated plane session.
No direct writes to collection configuration, publication snapshots or runtime activation heads.
No notification sends or workflow task actions.
